pack: GTEX Club Legacy 3D Asset Starter Pack
asset_style: stylized premium hard-surface starter models; fictional and brand-neutral

coordinate_system.origin: Centered around the model X/Z footprint; Y is up. Vehicle contact points are near y=0, stadium/campus grounds are near y=0 with a site base extending below it, and the watch includes a small display plinth.

assets.name: Aurelius X1 Private Jet
assets.recommended_use: Club Lifestyle / Assets showroom; owner profile collection
assets.dimensions_m: approx 17 m wingspan x 18.5 m length
assets.notes: Fictional private jet; no manufacturer branding.

assets.name: GTEX Voyager Club Coach
assets.recommended_use: Club profile transport display and luxury catalogue
assets.dimensions_m: body approx 2.52 m wide x 3.53 m high x 11.25 m long; mirrors extend total width to about 3.14 m
assets.notes: Generic premium coach design with abstract emblem only.

assets.name: Velocity R Hypercar
assets.dimensions_m: approx 2.1 m width x 1.3 m height x 4.6 m length
assets.notes: Fictional vehicle design; not based on a specific marque.

assets.name: Meridian Mechanical Watch
assets.recommended_use: Personal inventory, gifts, rarity collection and asset details
assets.dimensions_m: approx 0.046 m case diameter; approx 0.228 m strap length plus a small display plinth
assets.notes: Contains a small optional display plinth as a named submesh; viewer should frame from bounds.

assets.name: Legacy Arena Stadium
assets.dimensions_m: approx 174 m width x 244 m length; field about 68 x 105 m
assets.notes: Stylized oval-bowl geometry; simplified seating and pitch markings.

assets.name: GTEX Performance Campus
assets.recommended_use: Facilities, Academy and Training Centre showcase
assets.dimensions_m: approx 150 m width x 100 m length
assets.notes: Includes two training pitches, a youth pitch, performance building and campus details.

integration_notes: Reuse the repository’s existing renderer/importer and component conventions.
Do not add a second rendering framework before repository inspection.
For web rendering, GLB is supported by Three.js GLTFLoader; for Unity, use the project’s existing importer or an approved glTF importer such as glTFast.
Treat model display as cosmetic. Purchases, rarity, ownership, prices and asset transfers must stay server-authoritative.
